name: solo-block-record
title: The Solo Block Record
description: Every solo-mined Bitcoin block found by a small or home miner that could be verified on-chain, across all public solo pools. Each row links the block on mempool.space and the source that reported it. Where a winner never published a hashrate, the hashrate and the odds derived from it are empty rather than guessed. Published by SoloLuck.io at https://sololuck.io/legends and mirrored here daily from https://sololuck.io/api/legends/v1/.

resources.name: blocks
resources.title: Solo-mined blocks (CSV)
resources.description: One row per block, newest first. UTF-8, comma-separated, with a header row. An empty cell means the value is unknown.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the block was mined, UTC.

fields.name: pool
fields.description: Where the block was found: the pool named by the coinbase or by the report, or 'untagged coinbase' when the coinbase carries no pool tag.

fields.name: hardware
fields.description: The winner's hardware or hashrate as publicly reported, in words; 'hashrate not publicly reported' when the winner never published one.

fields.name: hashrate_hs
fields.description: Hashrate in hashes per second, as published by the miner, the pool operator or the press at the time. Empty when never published.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.description: Network difficulty at that height, as recorded: most rows are rounded to five or six significant figures, a few carry full precision.

fields.name: reward_btc
fields.description: Total block reward in BTC: subsidy plus fees.

fields.name: reward_usd_reported
fields.description: The reward's US dollar value as reported at the time, as free text (for example '≈ $300,000 then'). Empty when no report gave one.

fields.name: expected_seconds_per_block
fields.description: Expected seconds for that hashrate to find a block at that difficulty: difficulty × 2^32 / hashrate_hs. Empty when the hashrate is unknown.

fields.name: chance_per_day
fields.description: Probability of finding a block within one day at that hashrate and difficulty: 1 − e^(−86400 / expected_seconds_per_block). Empty when the hashrate is unknown.

fields.name: chance_per_day_one_in
fields.description: The same daily chance written as '1 in N': round(1 / chance_per_day). Empty when the hashrate is unknown.

fields.name: source_label
fields.description: The source that reported the block.

fields.name: story
fields.description: A short account of the block, in English.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Caveats, for example when an entry is inferred from the payout pattern rather than declared by the miner. Empty when there are none.

resources.name: blocks-json
resources.title: Solo-mined blocks with the dataset's own metadata (JSON)
resources.description: The same rows as data/blocks.csv under 'blocks', plus the publisher's metadata: version, method, inclusion rule, licence, cite_as and the CSV's sha256.
